title: Fix rejected drain PR #157 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72)
description:
Drain PR #157 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- [major] Scope creep: Added multiple helper functions (buildLineStarts, offsetToLine, countParams, matchBrace, matchParen, nearestOf, skipLiteralOrComment, scanFunctionDecl, scanArrowFn) that were not requested in the task — Remove all helper functions and implement scanFunctionMetrics as a focused export without internal complexity
- [major] Weakened test coverage: Missing tests for method shorthand, getter/setter accessors, class method shorthand, and async method patterns mentioned in PR description — Add comprehensive tests covering all supported function types as claimed
- [major] Silent fallback: The scanFunctionDecl function returns null on parsing failures instead of providing clear error information — Return structured errors or ensure robust parsing that doesn't silently fail
- [minor] Code quality: Multiple nested if statements and complex parsing logic in scanArrowFn function — Simplify arrow function parsing logic for maintainability
